note: No sale, list or excess funds are posted.

auction.venue: Before the courthouse door, Pike County Courthouse (wording of the most recent legal ad found, March 2018)
auction.time: First Tuesday of the sale month, 10:00 am to 4:00 pm, continuing the next day if necessary (2018 legal ad)
auction.payment: Cash or certified funds (2018 legal ad). No payment deadline is published.
vital: The Tax Sales page currently lists no sales. The venue and hours here come from a 2018 legal ad, so confirm them with the office.

Delinquent accounts are turned over to a collection contractor (GTS) with admin and levy fees of up to $215 or more added; the property is posted, photographed and advertised for four weeks before a sale.
Georgia law: tax sales are buyer beware (O.C.G.A. 9-13-167) and the tax deed carries no warranty of title.

Georgia law: the owner or any lienholder may redeem for 12 months after the sale, and until the right to redeem is foreclosed, by paying the bid plus a 20% premium, plus 10% for each additional year (O.C.G.A. 48-4-40 to 48-4-45).
Georgia law: any amount bid above the taxes and costs is held as excess funds for the former owner and lienholders (O.C.G.A. 48-4-5).
